fields.summary_ko.0: Dell Technologies (DELL) fell 7.2% on November 13, 2026; amid AI sector confusion following Nvidia CEO departure, selling pressure has pushed stock down 41% from year-to-date high of $588.40 to $344.53.
fields.summary_ko.1: Dell's AI server revenue represented $1.64 billion of $4.7 billion in Q2 2027 (35% share), with $9.5 billion AI backlog, though Q3 AI server revenue guidance of $1.9 billion due late November is a key focus.
